about_text:
Ever since I was young, I’ve been obsessed with documenting everything. Whether it was an ordinary moment or a big milestone, I always had a camera on hand. My style is natural and candid, capturing things as they really happen, but I also love to experiment with different artistic directions every now and then.

When I’m not hanging around other humans, I like to spend time out in the Canadian wilderness documenting our stunning landscapes and wildlife.
